The trace reports 0.0 kph among its distinct speeds and the driver then held the same spot for 400 continuous seconds, so the 15 kph 'still in motion' limb is not engaged either. ledger.claim: POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate this rider. Limb (a) fails: the only message in the chat log is the driver's own 'im at the pickup point' sent at 15:11:54 and read at 15:12:24 - the rider sent nothing during the waiting window. Limb (c) affirmatively fails rather than being undecidable: the rider's own track places the rider's device between 725.06 m and 732.21 m from the pickup pin across 67 fixes, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. The rider was not at the pickup point, and the rider's statement that they 'never saw the car' is consistent with their own device position.

POL-NS-03 does not govern this trip. That clause applies only where the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin. Here the driver's qualifying fixes lie inside the 50 m STANDARD radius, so this is not a wrong-entrance case and the wrong-entrance route to a full refund is not open. The case is decided on POL-NS-01, and the fee stands.

Because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the fee in force: 80 percent of SGD 4.50 is SGD 3.60, which is the fare breakdown's own driver_compensation figure. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 termination against 126 completed_trips_30d is a ratio of 0.0079, far below 0.08 - the check requires BOTH limbs. Those two fields are the only profile fields POL-NS-07 and POL-GEN-01 permit for this check, and both read in the driver's favour. Compensation is therefore paid, not withheld.

No limb of POL-NS-08 is engaged, so nothing on this record is impaired for policy purposes. The GPS trace has 92 fixes at a 10-second cadence, 100 percent coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds. There is no clock skew: the 'arrived' event at 15:11:34 matches the first qualifying fix at 15:11:34 and the termination at 15:18:15 is corroborated by the trace's last in-geofence fix at 15:18:14. The chat log's single message matches trip_record.chat_message_count of 1 with intact sequence numbering. And the fare breakdown's SGD 4.50 cancellation-fee line reconciles exactly to trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50. All four deciding artifacts (EV-TRIP-02721, EV-GPS-02721, EV-CHAT-02721, EV-FARE-02721) carry weight_multiplier 1.0.

No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger fires, so this case is decidable on the automated pipeline and the fee is neither refunded nor held. The deciding facts - arrival and dwell - rest on EV-TRIP-02721 and EV-GPS-02721, both at weight 1.0, so POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the platform floor no lower and confidence is well above 0.70. No admissible artifact contradicts the trip record on arrival, dwell or rider presence. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, below the 3 threshold in limb (d), the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so limb (c) is not met. Escalation would be the wrong disposition.

The disposition follows from POL-GEN-03. This is a rider-filed dispute and the SGD 4.50 has already been charged with no refund issued (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), so the rider's claim is not supported and the present state stands - the rider is not refunded. The outcome the case produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION of SGD 3.60, which under POL-GEN-03 carries the same figure in amount_sgd, leaves the fee in place, and is paid to the driver.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver: this dispute over trip TRP-02721 is decided on the record.

Outcome. The SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee stands and the driver is paid SGD 3.60 of it. Under POL-NS-01 all four conditions for a chargeable no-show are met: (a) the trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 15:11:34; (b) the GPS trace places him inside the pickup geofence from that same second; (c) he held position for 400 seconds against the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec); and (d) the driver terminated the trip at 15:18:15 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, 401 seconds after the dwell began, with no boarding event anywhere on the record.

The rider's arrival-test argument (POL-NS-02, POL-NS-12) is rejected. The rider is right that POL-NS-12 does not apply, because the arrival marker is a driver button press (arrival_marker BUTTON), not a platform-confirmed GPS_AUTO arrival. That does not defeat the trace. Its own computed geometry, produced under the policy's 25 m accuracy filter and the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, shows 41 consecutive in-geofence fixes from 15:11:34 to 15:18:14 with a minimum distance of 0.0 m from the pin; EV-GPS-02721 is admissible as COMPLETE with no issue codes at weight_multiplier 1.0; POL-NS-08(a) to (d) sets no accuracy limb; and the policy's integrity block treats a fix with no reported horizontal accuracy as of unknown accuracy, neither counted nor excluded by the 25 m filter. No artifact on the record shows the driver's fixes lack a reported accuracy, and the computed qualifying-fix count of 41 already reflects the filter. Limb (b) is therefore made out, and the rider's linked dwell argument under POL-NS-01(c) fails with it: the dwell runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 15:11:34, and 400 seconds comfortably exceeds the 180 seconds required. The driver's POL-NS-05 point is accepted: no false-arrival marker exists, because the 15:11:34 tap coincides with the driver at the pin (0.0 m) and at a recorded speed of 0.0 km/h, so neither the 300 m limb nor the 15 km/h limb is engaged. POL-NS-03 is not engaged either: the stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m arrival radius, not in the 400 m wrong-entrance band.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, and both advocates agree. Limb (a) fails because the only chat message is the driver's; limb (c) fails affirmatively because the rider's own track sits 725 to 732 m from the pin across 67 fixes, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius (rider_qualifying_fix_count 0). POL-NS-11's undecidable route is closed, so the rider's suggestion that limb (c) is merely unrun is rejected: it is affirmatively failed.

POL-NS-06 does not reduce the fee: there is no shortfall (400 s dwell against 180 s), there is only one in-geofence interval (run_count 1) for limb (i) to work with, and EV-ADVIS-02721-01 is MISSING. That artifact carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, so it can carry no fact and caps no finding here; the rider's citation of its absence is accepted only as showing that no advisory exists to extend the waiting clock either way.

POL-NS-07 fixes the payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force, which is SGD 3.60 - the figure the fare breakdown itself carries. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 against 126 completed trips in 30 days is a rate of 0.008, far below 0.08; the check requires both limbs. Those two fields are the only profile fields POL-NS-07 and POL-GEN-01 permit here, and the rider's own point that lifetime counters (prior_no_show_flags, prior_disputes_filed) are context only is accepted.

POL-NS-08 is not engaged on any limb: the trace has 92 fixes at a 10-second cadence with 100 percent coverage and no gap, the arrival event matches the first qualifying fix to the second, the chat log's single message matches trip_record.chat_message_count, and the SGD 4.50 cancellation-fee line reconciles to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50. Every deciding artifact (EV-TRIP-02721, EV-GPS-02721) carries weight_multiplier 1.0, so under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence cap is 1.0 and no POL-NS-09 trigger fires: no admissible artifact contradicts the trip record, both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and no impaired sole evidence exists. Confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor.

Under POL-GEN-03 the outcome this case produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION of SGD 3.60, and on that ruling amount_sgd carries the same figure, SGD 3.60; the rider's charge stands unchanged and no refund is due. The monetary effect of SGD 3.60 is below the SGD 8.00 threshold in POL-GEN-05, so the ruling executes automatically, and either party may appeal it once under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
